output.explanation: Verified the pinned commit and left the checkout unchanged. The central tree now nests the current AgentSession and service references under AgentSessionRuntime, then places the Agent, held SessionManager, ExtensionRunner, CacheWarmer, tool registry and coordination state under AgentSession. Three peripheral diagrams elaborate the engine, canonical history and shared services. Arrows distinguish calls and borrowed references from containment. Source checks clarified that ModelRegistry delegates to ModelRuntime, retry omission also removes matching tool results from the projection, warming persists usage entries, and reload emits session_start only when extension bindings exist. Loop helpers and compaction/export helpers are shown as operations or dependencies, not independently owned components.
